mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_user (id, username, nickname, password_hash, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{nickname}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, password_hash AS passwordHash, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser FROM platform_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
